message.content:
Here are some fun true or false questions to introduce a new teacher to your students. 素晴らしい ideas can make the first day of school truly memorable for everyone in your lovely new 教室. Try these five questions during your first period to get students excited about meeting the new 先生. Each one is a lighthearted challenge that helps the whole class bond and feel excited about 学校.

Q1: True or False, I own a pet dragon named Taro. Answer: False. It is actually 猫 named Taro.

Q2: True or False, I can juggle three bowling balls at once. Answer: False. 嘘! I can only juggle one and it always drops.

Q3: True or False, I met a 俳優 in a grocery store. Answer: True. It was a movie star buying milk.

True or False, 蜘蛛 scare me more than heights. Answer: True. Heights scare me more.

Q5: True or False, I 旅 to three continents this year. Answer: False. Only two so far.

These lighthearted questions make the 日 memorable and help students feel excited about the school year ahead.
